CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS destinations (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  slug VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  state VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  region VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  best_time VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  budget_per_person INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10000,
  rating REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 4.5,
  image TEXT,
  tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  context TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hotels (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  destination_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES destinations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  area VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mid-range',
  price_per_night INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2500,
  rating REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
  note TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS places (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  destination_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES destinations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sightseeing',
  time_needed VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '2 hours',
  entry_fee VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Free',
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tips (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  destination_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES destinations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  category VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  text TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trips (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  destination_id INTEGER,
  destination_slug VARCHAR(120),
  destination_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  travellers INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  budget_per_person INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10000,
  start_date VARCHAR(20),
  pace VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'balanced',
  prompt TEXT,
  itinerary JSONB NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  destination_slug VARCHAR(120),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hotels_destination_id_idx ON hotels(destination_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS places_destination_id_idx ON places(destination_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS tips_destination_id_idx ON tips(destination_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS trips_user_id_idx ON trips(user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages_user_id_idx ON chat_messages(user_id)
